detail.longDescription: 🚀 CloudNativePG 1.30.1 & 1.29.3 are out! These maintenance updates bring improved failover behavior along with key fixes and enhancements across supported series (1.30 & 1.29). They also lay the groundwork for v1.31.0, which will make high availability and failover even more solid. Check the release notes and update to the latest patch release for your series: https:// cloudnative-pg.io/releases/clo udnative-pg-1-30.1-released/ # PostgreSQL # Kubernetes
